title: Supporting Reauthentication into Private Access via Microsoft IWA with Kerberos

blocks.text: To support reauthentication for application access into Private Access (ZPA) when single sign-on (SSO) is set up using Microsoft Integrated Windows Authentication (IWA) with Kerberos, you must complete the following procedure.

If you do not set up an application segment with an associated timeout access policy rule as detailed in the following steps, an error message displays in Zscaler Client Connector whenever your users attempt to reauthenticate.
If you need to use FQDNs, you must create an application segment for each domain.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > Defined Application Segments.
Click Add Application Segment.

blocks.text: The Add Application Segment window appears.

blocks.item: In the Add Application Segment window:
On the Define Applications page:
Under Applications, enter the FQDN for ADFS.
Under Client Connector Access, enter 443 in the TCP Port Ranges fields.
Under Additional Configuration, from the Bypass drop-down menu, select On Corporate Network.
Click Next.
See image.
On the Segment Group page, select the proper segment group to add this application segment to, or create a new segment group. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
Complete the configuration for the application segment.
After saving the previous application segment, click Add Application Segment again.
In the Add Application Segment window:
On the Define Applications page:
Under Applications, enter the FQDN for LDAP/Active Directory.
Under Client Connector Access, enter 389, 636, and 3268-3269 in the TCP Port Ranges and UDP Port Ranges fields.
Under Additional Configuration, from the Bypass drop-down menu, select On Corporate Network.
Click Next.
See image.
On the Segment Group page, select the proper segment group to add this application segment to, or create a new segment group. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
Complete the configuration for the application segment.
After saving the previous application segment, click Add Application Segment again.
In the Add Application Segment window:
On the Define Applications page:
Under Applications, enter the FQDN for KDC.
Under Client Connector Access, enter 88 in the TCP Port Ranges and UDP Port Ranges fields.
Under Additional Configuration, from the Bypass drop-down menu, select On Corporate Network.
Click Next.
See image.
On the Segment Group page, select the proper segment group to add this application segment to, or create a new segment group. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Policy > Timeout Policy.
Click Add.
The Add Timeout Policy window appears.
In the Add Timeout Policy window:
For Authentication Timeout: Select Never.
For Criteria: Click Add Criteria, click Applications, and for Segment Groups, select the groups you chose previously.
See image.
Complete the configuration for the timeout policy.
